meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在你构建或修改任何用户界面后，自动进行严格的视觉质量检查。它会截取屏幕截图，与参考图对比，并检查设计系统、功能正确性和文字显示，最终给出“通过”或“不通过”的结论。
howto.when: 当你构建或修改了网页界面或终端界面，并询问它“看起来对吗”时触发。也适用于你怀疑界面有回归问题、文字显示异常或布局错位时。

say.text: 我刚改完这个页面，帮我做一次视觉质量检查。
say.note: Claude 会截取当前页面截图，与参考图对比，并运行检查。

say.text: 检查这个终端界面的布局和文字对齐。
say.note: Claude 会捕获终端渲染结果，检查宽度、边框和文字对齐。

say.text: 对比这个组件和设计稿的像素差异。
say.note: Claude 会运行像素对比，给出差异比例和热点区域。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically performs rigorous visual QA when you build or modify any UI. It captures screenshots, compares them with references, checks design system integrity, functionality, and CJK text, then outputs a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggered after building or changing any web/page or terminal UI, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Also when suspecting regression, text clipping, or layout misalignment.

say_en.text: I just finished editing this page. Run a visual QA check.
say_en.note: Claude will capture the page, compare with reference, and run checks.

say_en.text: Check the layout and text alignment of this terminal UI.
say_en.note: Claude will capture the terminal render and check width, borders, and alignment.

say_en.text: Compare this component with the design mock for pixel differences.
say_en.note: Claude will run pixel diff and report diff ratio and hotspots.
